info.title: CAO dashboard server
info.description: The Go dashboard server HTTP contract. Local mode uses a loopback bearer capability; hosted mode uses an authorized GitHub OAuth session and X-CSRF-Token on protected mutations. The optional MCP HTTP transport is covered, but its protocol messages and tool schemas are owned by the MCP contract; dashboard static assets are outside this contract.

post.description: Start an asynchronous rebuild coordinated by the selected operational store; local bearer or hosted admin session and CSRF on hosted mutations. Hosted rebuilds require durable audit admission and start evidence; an unavailable audit service fails closed before reconciliation. Lifecycle events correlate actor, rebuildId, prior revision and terminal outcome without payloads. Canonical publication, audit appends and replaceable status are separate commits: terminal audit failures report auditState=unavailable where status storage remains available, never roll back a published revision, and require operator reconciliation of incomplete histories. Local bearer mode retains capability-level attribution, not personal identity or a durability guarantee. A volatile collector also reconstructs GitHub scope and reruns backfill, even with a populated lake, when durable audit is supplied. Canonical ingestion and existing-database maintenance curate Audits according to dashboard-data.md section 11.1, including unchanged artifact inputs. Changed retained data publishes a new revision; missing Run evidence, grader/eval identities, and actionable diagnostics remain retained.

post.description: Implements the v1.2 wire contract merged in github/gh-aw#70429 at be70cb4ec4317135a1ab21d5b830b6fae7d5be4a, not the incompatible nine-field/correlation_id v1.0 contract merged in #70286 at d9abaf92a50fd8778f12fa122138b30c75daf8f2. Optional hosted service, authenticated exclusively with an Actions RS256 OIDC bearer token from the compiler-owned admission job and an independently configured audience. No OAuth cookie, CSRF token, GitHub API token, redirect or credential fallback. Every response is no-store and has no trace, quota, reset or reason headers. All durable denials are identical empty 403s; transient dependency failures are empty 503s. Spend-independent probe limiting may return empty 429s. Valid caller traceparent parents the server HTTP span and its dependencies; invalid or duplicate trace context starts a fresh server trace without changing the decision. Baggage and tracestate are ignored; sampling is locally controlled. The initial supported claim profile is GitHub.com, string audience, non-reusable workflows; unsupported reusable identities fail closed.

post.description: Optional, request-only organization GitHub App broker implementing the gh-aw exchange shape. Authentication is exclusively the oidc_token in the JSON body, not OAuth, CSRF, a bearer header, or admission. The exact configured HTTPS endpoint is the OIDC audience. Enrolled immutable owner/repository IDs, workflow reference and SHA, trusted event/ref and signed job identity must match before issuance. App private keys are read from Azure Key Vault using managed identity. All responses are no-store with empty failure bodies. This initial single-process profile does not claim integrated-deployment conformance; actual Copilot use and renewal require operator acceptance.

get.description:
Read-only, repository-scoped GitHub metadata through CAO. Local deployments
use the server's gh CLI credential; hosted deployments use a GitHub App.
Missing credentials or unavailable live access return 503, never a browser
redirect to GitHub. Static Pages deployments have no live endpoint.
Browsers use HttpOnly session cookies, never GitHub credentials or bearer
tokens in the resource configuration. Local bootstrap issues a Secure,
SameSite=Strict cookie scoped only to these read-only resource routes.
Normalized resources are retained in the deployment's Postgres data store.
Responses are private caches with a five-minute freshness window and
stale-while-revalidate support. Send If-None-Match to reuse cached data.

post.description: Execute timeline, summary, or the local-only session-query Dashboard Language profile for one exact authorized repository, with an additional full-trace-read grant and (hosted) CSRF token. Maximum request 4096 bytes, result 8 MiB/10000 rows, and execution 30 seconds; backend budgets may be tighter. Hosted session-query requests fail explicitly with 422, never fall back. Authorization is rechecked inside withdrawal-aware result delivery through the final response write. Corrections use active projection membership before any analytical operation; withdrawal overrides historical/pinned readers. A budget failure is an error, not a complete-looking truncated trace. An explicit query.limit is intentional selection, reported separately from evidence coverage. Existing SQLite/PostgreSQL dashboard queries remain on their existing backends. Hosted Blob/ADX query activation additionally requires generation-bound live Azure conformance; upload success or a local simulator does not establish that evidence.

post.description:
Explicitly publish one skill-generated evidence packet (maximum 8 MiB) to
PostgreSQL. No workflow discovery, acquisition, evaluator execution or
scheduled evaluation is performed. Requires a hosted administrator OAuth
session with current step-up assurance and CSRF, or a local bearer
capability backed by PostgreSQL; local SQLite is read-only.

Repository and workflow must already be observed. Publication is atomic,
namespace-scoped and survives Activity snapshot replacement. Exact retries
do not advance the revision. Older/conflicting captures, changed frozen
contracts and rewritten immutable history are rejected. A new publication
advances the query revision and notifies active dashboard subscriptions.
Evidence capture/cutoff timestamps are retained, never replaced with upload
time. All evidence timestamps must be representable at PostgreSQL
microsecond precision; finer nonzero fractions are rejected, not rounded.
The body is the original single schema-v2 JSONL transport envelope.

get.description: OAuth profiles only. Exchange the GitHub OAuth code and signed state; sets the HttpOnly session and CSRF cookies, then redirects home. Local development authenticates only the exact configured developer login without membership reads; its sessions cannot be reused in ordinary hosted mode or for a different configured developer. Mismatched or unauthorized callbacks are rejected and issued credentials are revoked or queued for revocation. Failure pages are HTML.

get.description: Hosted profile only. A public, static HTML confirmation page.

OAuth profiles only. Ordinary hosted login requests read:org read:user for classic OAuth Apps, or offline_access for GitHub Apps. The explicitly configured CAO_GITHUB_LOCAL_USER single-user development mode requires direct loopback HTTPS, requests read:user without read:org, and replaces organization/team authorization with an exact configured GitHub login. It cannot be selected by a request parameter or used by remote/external/platform hosting. hosted_cli=1 explicitly starts repository consent only when hosted CLI is enabled and the existing server-side session belongs to a configured administrator with a known GitHub account ID. Classic OAuth adds repo only for that flow. Its signed state binds the initiating session, account ID, login and ten-minute expiry; the callback must retain that subject and current administrator authorization. The query parameter alone grants no authority.

AdmissionAllowances.description: Independent policy allowances, not remaining spend or reservations. The gh-aw client applies validated values to the corresponding runtime caps; omitted optional allowances preserve component policy. Wire numbers are plain positive decimal integers. Approval also idempotently publishes a sparse canonical Run with status admitted before returning 200; denied/blocked attempts publish no run. Publication failure is transient and preserves the original decision for retry.

triggering_actor.description: Informational only; the initial server profile never authorizes or attributes spend from this unsigned value.

AdmissionRequest.description: Activation-only gh-aw admission metadata. All identifiers are exact decoded strings; run numbers use canonical positive ASCII decimal spelling. Unknown or duplicate fields, invalid Unicode, query parameters and bodies over 8192 bytes are denied. workflow_hash is an untrusted cache hint, never authority.

BrokerCredential.description: Only the credential and its actual upstream expiry are returned; no provider endpoint or other authority is conveyed.

load.description: Half-life 60 seconds: each event contributes one unit, decaying by half every minute. Keys are webhook, collection, and failure.

triggering_actor.description: Informational only; the initial server profile never authorizes or attributes spend from this unsigned value.

session.description: Compact profile 1 JSONL: at most 128 allowlisted records and 16384 UTF-8 bytes including one LF per record. Only the pinned compact metadata vocabulary and eligible finite-number/boolean/256-byte scalar strings are accepted; no prompts, messages, tool arguments/results or arbitrary nested data. Empty is valid, not proof of zero activity.

usage_artifact_ids.description: At most two unique canonical decimal strings, retry upload first. Locators only: this service records them but performs no artifact retrieval or hydration. Missing full sessions remain unavailable.

ConclusionRequest.description: Exactly the ten admission identity strings plus these three fields. Maximum 65536 UTF-8 request bytes, with an independently bounded 8192-byte identity. Unknown/duplicate members, invalid Unicode, unsafe counters, malformed JSONL and out-of-profile metadata are denied. Session content and artifact IDs are untrusted evidence, never authority or complete accounting.

oidc_token.description: Signed GitHub Actions identity with the exact public exchange URL as its string audience. Never a GitHub API token.

CopilotRequestExchange.description: GitHub Actions OIDC exchange for organization-billed Copilot inference. Additional and duplicate members are rejected.

evaluatedAt.description: Authoritative source time of the active canonical dataset, when available.

Facet.description: Terminal projection of processed rows into at most 64 chart panels. Declare field alone, or row and/or column; as names each panel's ordered row sequence.

GitHubRelease.description: The latest published release, not an inferred version or a list of assets.

GitHubRepository.description: Safe repository metadata; upstream credentials and unrestricted GitHub payloads are never returned.

redis.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for the selected operational dependency, not a claim that Redis is installed.

revision.description: Details are present only for an authorized caller.

type.description: inner and left require unique right keys; inner-many explicitly expands all matching rows within query budgets. Missing or blank keys never match.

recoveryReady.description: False until a volatile collector has reconstructed authoritative GitHub scope.

QueryDefinition.description: A Dashboard Language query definition. See dashboard/site/dashboard.json for the language vocabulary.

QueryRequest.description: Requests may supply query definitions or use server-configured definitions.

rebuildId.description: Server-generated lifecycle correlation, independent of the private lease owner token.

auditState.description: pending, recorded (durable), local (non-durable capability-level evidence), or unavailable. Publication success does not imply terminal evidence was persisted.

counts.description: Retained collection counts after canonical Audit curation and relationship validation; not transport input counts.

RevisionEvent.description: JSON object within each SSE data frame (not the wire framing itself).

ServerLogRedis.description: Only fixed, numeric ingestion counters are returned; Redis keys and values are never exposed.

gaps.description: Durable source/admission gaps remain visible and reacquirable; zero does not imply complete upstream logs.

select.description: Required for non-aggregate queries. Only generated scalar event columns are allowed; PayloadJSON and Gaps are not query fields.

limit.description: Intentional top-N selection after aggregation, projection and deterministic ordering. Omitted means the complete result must fit the independent response budget.

SessionArchiveDefinition.description: Local DuckDB analytical profile of Dashboard Language, not a full dashboard document. Unknown keys and fields fail before execution. Predicates are conjunctive, with exactly one of equals, in, or a gte/lt range. String comparisons are exact and case-sensitive; ordering is typed, with UTF-8 lexical string order and empty strings last.

repository.description: Exact lowercase owner/repository in the reviewed archive and collection scope.

runId.description: Required positive GitHub run ID for timeline; forbidden for summary. Not a canonical Run ID or trace digest.

attempt.description: Required positive exact attempt for timeline; forbidden for summary.

limit.description: Maximum complete output rows, 1-10000 (default 10000). Exceeding a limit fails, never truncates a full approved trace.

language-version.description: Required only for kind=session-query. Hosted ADX does not support this analytical profile.

query.description: Required only for kind=session-query; runId, attempt and envelope limit are forbidden.

SessionArchiveQuery.description: Trusted archive queries. No SQL/KQL, object names, filesystem paths, or cross-store joins are accepted. Query-only fields are forbidden on legacy templates and vice versa. Optional fields must be omitted rather than null.

limited.description: Whether the explicit analytical limit omitted matching output rows. Never indicates a silently exceeded resource budget.

upstreamCoverage.description: Always unknown: archive coverage is not proof of complete upstream history.

admissionGaps.description: Repository-scoped durable acquisition/admission gaps at the pinned generation's assessment.

tracesWithGaps.description: Retained active traces with recorded omissions, before user filtering; distinct from admission gaps.

rows.description: Present even for an empty analytical result. Integer values are serialized without float conversion.

SessionArchiveResult.description: One authorized pinned generation. Approved payload JSON, explicit nulls, sequence, identity, omissions and provenance follow the shared trace contract, not another HTTP-only evidence model.

stage.description: Active is a running lifecycle, not proof that pending evidence is published or that Azure acceptance gates passed.

queryKinds.description: Enabled local archives advertise timeline, summary, session-query; hosted archives advertise timeline and summary only.

SessionCompaction.description: Loss/coverage metadata for compact unified-session profile 1, not a completeness or billing assertion. Counters are nonnegative JavaScript-safe integers.

TokenBrokerInvalidation.description: Cleanup obtains a fresh identity for the same verified job; it never includes an issued credential.

Sequence.description: Zero-based contiguous event ordering within the approved trace.

ContentDigest.description: SHA-256 of the concatenated UTF-8 JSON content, in Part order.

RunId.description: Trace identity, not necessarily a GitHub workflow run ID.

TraceId.description: Canonical RunId above is distinct from this hashed native trace identity.

CompletionDay.description: Empty means undated, never a fabricated source clock.

PayloadJSON.description: Full approved event as UTF-8 JSON; absent and explicit null remain distinct.

RunId.description: Trace identity, not necessarily a GitHub workflow run ID.

Part.description: Zero-based contiguous chunk ordering within Sequence.

Trace.TraceContentParts.description: UTF-8 JSON text chunks split on rune boundaries, never base64 or source bytes.

Trace.TraceDatasets.description: DatasetId identifies the immutable dataset; ProjectionId binds its source trace version.

Trace.TraceEpisodes.description: ProjectionId is the independent mining version, not the trace version.

Sequence.description: Zero-based contiguous event ordering within the approved trace.

ContentDigest.description: SHA-256 of the concatenated UTF-8 JSON content, in Part order.

ProducingAttempt.description: Zero means unknown; the enclosing RunAttempt is not proof of output production.

Trace.TraceSampleFrames.description: RunId identifies a frozen sample frame.

UnsupportedCopilotTaskExchange.description: A known but unsupported capability; identity and enrollment are verified before returning 501.

ValueEvidencePacket.description: Original bounded facts from a validated operational-value skill report, not HTML or computed dashboard labels.

WebhookStatus.description: Bounded in-memory counters for requests that reached this process's webhook handler. Reset on restart, not aggregated across replicas. Accepted means HTTP acknowledgement, not completed reconciliation or verified GitHub-side registration.

WindowField.description: An ordered rolling, change, previous-value or row-number operation, evaluated after aggregation and before temporal-series projection. previous preserves scalar type; row-number is one-based.
